what: Each letter of the big title is folded like a door — odd letters hinge on the right, even letters on the left, turning 90° on Y, shifted down 2.34vw, with 10px blur. When visible (or when the user adds the class="is-in" ...is added) each character opens in turn .1s apart over 1s (.5s for the first) and clears up as it goes. When the state is released, it folds back all at once after hold seconds and waits for the next — slider title hold 1 (stays as is during the 1s slide), popup title 0

options.mode: If state, the side that uses it without a visibility check is class="is-in" Add and remove it (active slide of the slider). Default: once when visible
options.each: Gap between characters (s), default .1 — .2 for the big title in the original popup
options.dur: Text duration (s), default 1 — the large title in the original popup is 2
options.hold: Time from the state releasing until it folds (sec), default 0 — original slider Heading 1

from.where: index.html .bf-slide__title (section slider title, mode: state · hold 1) · .bf-panel__title (popup big title, each .2 · dur 2) — in the original, glyph spans have transform-origin right on odd and left on even, opacity 0 · translate 0 calc(90*100vw/3840) · rotate y 90deg · blur(10px) → when active, the first character is delayed .5s .1s, the next characters 1s n×.1s (popup 2s n×.2s), cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1). Inactive collapses with all 0s linear 1s (slider) · 0s (popup). On phone, lengths and delays are all halved

note: In the original each letter was one image (overlaid on a title-width image) — here the letters are split into spans. Applying no perspective to the hinge rotation is also as in the original (Y 90° flattens it horizontally)
